findings.label: Test stubs — no actual test logic
findings.description: All three features have placeholder test files with TODO comments but zero executable test cases. The plan required basic integration tests; without test evidence the endpoints cannot be validated to work correctly.

findings.label: Missing build/test evidence
findings.description: The code-progress.md file does not record the output of `cargo build` or `cargo test`. The instructions stated the coder must record this evidence; without it, blocking concerns cannot be ruled out and verification is incomplete.

findings.label: README not updated with endpoint documentation
findings.description: The plan required README updates documenting analytics, invoice, and subscription endpoints. No such updates exist, leaving operators without API documentation for the new features.

findings.label: Subscription charge completion hook not implemented
findings.description: Plan item 18 required that when a payment status changes to 'completed', pending subscription_charges are marked 'completed'. This hook is missing; subscription charges remain pending forever, breaking the charge lifecycle and merchant visibility into charge completion.

findings.label: Analytics cache missing TTL configuration
findings.description: The moka cache is initialized with `Cache::new(1000)` which only sets capacity, not expiry. The plan required a 60-second TTL; without `time_to_idle` or `time_to_live` configuration, cached entries persist indefinitely, violating the requirement.
